Then: lin2 παίδι => παιδὶ (there's no diaeresis, btw). || lin5 ὧπερ => ὡπερ || lin9 ἀποδώσεως => <:ἀποδόσεως|reg|ἀποδώσεως:> || lin10 ἀσφ(άλειον) => ἀσφ(αλὲς) (PN corr.) || lin11 ἐνγεγραμμένα: replace corrupt subdots from within PN || lin14 Σ]αβῖνος Ἀρσυλίου πράκ[τωρ] μαρτυρῶ is wrong but I cannot take things further. Then, (hand 1) † διʼ ἐμοῦ Κυρίλλ[ου] Σαβ(ίνου) ἐγράφη belongs to a new line, lin15. Renumber verso (15 => 16) and correct Αὐρήλιου to Αὐρηλίου.

Submit - I have integrated most of BL VIII and IX. I have not added BL corrections on l. 8, as the reading of the ed.pr. (ὀξον̣άρια) is much more convincing on the photo. I have added some minor PN corrections from a photo that I am happy to share. There are other dubious readings in the edition, but I haven't included corrections I was not convinced about.
